mathematical_result.statement: For every 0<delta,eta<1 there are two owner-target matrices at operator distance <delta and one common cap-one product law whose quadratic-output laws have TV distance at least 1-eta after every deterministic output translation; both have canonical C0 densities, with the base height at least 4/3 and perturbed height at most 4eta/3.
mathematical_result.scope_warning: This is not a counterexample to QFORM; the small perturbation flattens the output. It forbids an operator-norm continuity/discard-the-tail step under arbitrary cap-one supports.

partner_result_applied.application: Applied Theorem 6.1 to P(Q_e in I)<=|I|/L, obtaining canonical p_e in C0 with the identical height 1/L; also applied to the diagonal pi interval bound for A_0.

frontier_dependency.use: The determinant-collapse funnel produces operator-nearness to rank<=3 but explicitly retains residuals/tail; the new B15 theorem proves operator-nearness alone cannot justify uniform law or density-height replacement.

remaining_implication: In B19's rank-three latent-collapse chamber, retain the small latent direction and physical residual/tail exactly or absorb them with a translation-uniform, product-provenance-sensitive receiver; operator-norm perturbation continuity is unavailable.
